column1: # ProteinGym MODEL−LOOKUP analysis for pgym_instructprotein: the one non-text
# arm EXP-R2-240's gap campaign leaves with a fitness score and no analysis.
# WHERE THE GAP COMES FROM. pgym_instructprotein was re-run on freeze
# 20260916123929_496a52beb8f2 as cell `pgym_instructprotein` of
# campaign_proteingym_nontxt_gap_rerun.tsv, and it is terminal there:
# `exited-ok`, `FAILURES 0`, writing
# results/external_baseline/20260916123929_496a52beb8f2/pgym_instructprotein/model_instructprotein.json
# (56537 B, sha256 7c1bdbad…, matching the sidecar the queue wrote beside it).
# That payload records 213 assays scored and 4 skipped, every skip on the shared
# context reason. No analyse cell was ever run against it, so this arm has a
# MODEL−LOOKUP it owes and does not have. This manifest carries exactly that one
# analysis and nothing else.
# THE 213-ASSAY SUPPORT IS A CONTEXT FACT, NOT A CORPUS GAP. InstructProtein's
# staged checkpoint declares context 2048 -- read back from the loaded config,
# not echoed from the request, in the payload's own
# `loader.checkpoint_facts.context` -- so it drops only the four assays whose
# maximum rendered length exceeds that window: A0A140D2T1_ZIKV_Sourisseau_2019
# (3426 tokens), BRCA2_HUMAN_Erwood_2022_HEK293T (3421),
# POLG_CXB3N_Mattenberger_2021 (2188) and POLG_HCVJF_Qi_2014 (3036). Those are
# exactly the four the 2048-context progen2-base rung drops, and not the 16 the
# 1024-context arms (progen2-small, rita-xl, zymctrl, proteinglm-7b-clm) drop.
# The frozen census is 217 assays; this arm's support is 213 and is read on its
# own support, never intersected with another arm's.
# WHICH ANALYSE AND WHY -- NOT RESTATED HERE. The evidence is in
# campaign_proteingym_nontxt_gap_rerun.tsv's header, whose second cell already
# ran this same stage's own `analyse` over progen2-small/base: the native helper
# cannot serve these arms (`_arm_family` knows only galactica/rita and raises
# `KeyError`) and 42_scale_capability.py is fixed at three rungs. This cell is
# that cell's invocation with one arm changed, on the ground that
# `analyse` loads no model and treats every arm identically.
# `instructprotein` IS A `--arms` CHOICE FOR `analyse`. It enters `SCOREABLE_ARMS`
# through `INSTRUCTPROTEIN_CORPUS` rather than `STAGED_ARMS`, and argparse's
# `--arms choices` is exactly `sorted(SCOREABLE_ARMS)`, so it parses; `--stages
# analyse` needs nothing else of it. Checked locally both ways on this checkout:
# `--stages analyse --arms instructprotein` is accepted and proceeds past
# argument and arm validation (it stops only on the absent test
# `--proteingym-dir`), while `--arms not-an-arm` exits 2 with `invalid choice`.
# `corpus_record` resolves the arm, which `_arm_analysis` calls.
# NO PROBE IS NEEDED. `interface_check.json` is an artefact of
# native_dms_extension.py's family table only; this stage has no `--probe`
# argument and its analyse path reads no probe.
# `analyse` has no path flags -- it reads its inputs from its own `--out`, as the
# ProGen2 cell's header records -- so all four are staged into this cell's output
# directory before dispatch:
#   wildtypes.json             45503 B  e080a37758e29c664d71e2a080f990f0bc0e8efdffbae7678b4a8b6271045faa
#   lookup.json               335133 B  1209b6c12d81c3d27020a3d87b00c253e4e70fc22f6bdaa150b8b0c9ef026ec3
#   profiles.json              73862 B  55bcbe12e3449b07602c3c0a3327ad8bc903fd7d864d379a1478b4cf96d37872
#   model_instructprotein.json 56537 B  7c1bdbad7abc273668e0c1e1725bcd31cf7e85d5baeb431fba40313f167d9e11
# The first three are byte-identical to the frozen set the ProGen2 analyse cell
# read from results/external_baseline/20260916123929_496a52beb8f2/pgym_progen2_small_base_analyse/;
# lookup.json and wildtypes.json are also the plan-134 catalogue staged at
# results/external_baseline/20260913131730_d91171619815/native_dms_inputs/ and
# carry the same digests there. model_instructprotein.json is copied in-pod from
# the cell that produced it and verified against that run's own SHA-256 sidecar.
# `--seed 20260807` and `--bootstrap 2000` are the stage's own defaults and are
# stated because the frozen lookup.json and the score payload were produced at
# that seed.
# blosum62_reproduces_frozen is withheld: it is a whole-benchmark statement over
# 217 assays and this arm reaches 213.
# One cell, on `cpu`. `analyse` loads no model, needs no card, and the 4-GPU
# pod's card 1 is running an unrelated long score cell; a cpu row takes no GPU
# gate, so this cell cannot disturb that run, and it does not touch the separate
# 1-GPU allocation at all.
